literal_meaning: কম্বল ছাড়ছে না (The blanket is not being removed or let go)
figurative_meaning_en: Stubborn or unrelenting; refusing to give up or let go
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কোনোমতেই পয়সা ফেরত দিতে চায় না, কম্বল ছাড়ছে না।
এই বাচ্চাটা খাবার ছাড়ছে না, কম্বল ছাড়ছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He refuses to return the money no matter what; he's not letting go of the blanket.
This child won't stop eating; he's clinging to it like not shedding the blanket.
note: The idiom draws from the image of someone or something tenaciously holding onto a blanket, often in a cold or protective context, symbolizing unwillingness to relinquish.
